reviewKind: Current local evidence review; no live Backend, hosted CI, staging, production runtime, independent peer review, or user acceptance claim.

trackerBeforeFE028Closeout.meaning: Canonical progress.mjs snapshot before refreshing FE028; the tracker counts current checkpoint evidence, not source-code completion.

rubric.meaning: Count of gates supported as passing within the explicitly scoped Frontend artifact. FE-G05 and FE-G09 remain unresolved; this ratio is not a code-completion or production-readiness score.

gates.title: Môi trường tái lập
gates.basis: Isolated clean copy used the current lockfile for npm ci, audit, setup, verify and production/demo builds. All 10 recorded command stages exited 0; source and copied lock SHA-256 match.
limits: Windows local runner only; hosted CI was not run.
npm retained lifecycle-script approval notices for esbuild and MSW; no approval was inferred.

gates.title: Code và kiến trúc
gates.basis: Current verify passed generated freshness, source/domain/boundary checks, lint, strict TypeScript, 138 Vitest tests and UI layout/token/composition/evidence gates. FE028 architecture review inspected the actual app, module, transport, mock and public entry boundaries.
limits: Architecture review is Codex self-review; no independent peer review is claimed.

gates.title: Contract và mocks
gates.basis: Canonical generated contract checks and current synthetic domain/network plus unit suites passed. FE026 clean regression contract tests passed 7/7; the app selects MSW only in demo/test mode.
limits: Synthetic contract/mock behavior does not prove a live API, provider, server transaction, or persistence behavior.

gates.title: Phủ chức năng
gates.basis: Current built-demo browser run passed 512/512 (256 Chromium and 256 Firefox). The source-linked matrix covers 54 routes, 64 features, 65 feature-route rows, 22 journeys, private-route roles 357/357 across 51 routes and seven roles, empty 11/11, error 51/51, and zero untested applicable state cells.
limits: This is local React UI coverage with synthetic MSW. UI role cases are not server-side authorization evidence.

gates.title: UI/UX và accessibility
gates.basis: Current automated evidence includes 54-route axe runs, keyboard-only 18/18, layout/visual-token/composition gates, reflow, 200% Chromium browser zoom, 200% Firefox text-only zoom, forced-colors/reduced-motion observation and selected visual reviews.
limits: Narrator speech/transcript and broad human accessibility/conformance review were not run. No full WCAG conformance claim is made.
Automated spacing/token gates and selected screenshots do not prove rendered semantic spacing parity for every route and state.

gates.title: An toàn Frontend
gates.basis: Isolated current npm audit found zero vulnerabilities. Current UI security/session/network tests are included in the passing verify and browser suite; production smoke showed an explicit unavailable error without automatic mock fallback.
limits: Does not prove server authorization, real tenant isolation, secret handling by a live deployment, or backend security.

gates.title: Hiệu năng Frontend
gates.basis: Current local demo preview measured Chromium 153 and Firefox 155 using the named 1,000-customer synthetic dataset. Initial-route gzip was 453,567 bytes; the 20-row page returned 1,004 total records in 354 ms Chromium and 433 ms Firefox. Largest production chunks were 328,326 bytes raw for MUI and 313,031 bytes raw for charts.
limits: Synthetic local browser measurements are not physical-device, CDN, production-user, or backend SLO evidence.

gates.title: Artifact và CI
gates.basis: Clean production and demo builds passed and reproduced byte-for-byte. Production tree has 34 files, no mock worker and no inspected MSW/seed markers; demo tree has 38 files and includes its worker. Focused built-demo preview passed 8/8. The approved gate accepts this clean local equivalent.
limits: GitHub Actions and branch protection were not run or verified; no hosted CI PASS is claimed.

gates.title: UAT và bàn giao
gates.basis: Technical mock UAT matrix, selected screenshots/trace, commands, hashes, test results, limitations and handoff are prepared. Final owner/user acceptance has not been recorded.
limits: The assistant cannot record the user's acceptance decision.
